calls.reason: This is a rhetorical description of a contested term, not a measurable fact. Anthropic's docs show agents are language models running in tool loops, which partly fits his description, but it's one vendor's view and doesn't settle what the term means.

The 3% figure comes from Bank of America payment data on its own customers, and he presents it as covering all households. A Parks survey found 16% of US households use paid AI, though use is not the same as paying, so the picture is mixed.
